column1: # UP Meru 2: the line plan, line by line.
#   (MERU_2_Leinenplan_Linemap.pdf, one page, a scanned image), supplied by
# Transcribed 2026-10-19 from the drawing: each line and the line it hangs
#   from. A parent that is not a line is where the cascade ends: a riser, or
#   the brake handle. The drawing does not say which riser the stabilo line
#   is fixed to, so it ends at "riser S".
# Two risers, as on the Torre: a and b anchors share a line, c and d anchors
#   share a line, and there is no B or D main line.
# The stabilo's six canopy lines are sa1 to sb3 here and on the totals sheet;
#   UP's component sheets call them a13 to a15 and c13 to c15. "also" gives
#   the component sheets' name, and the published totals settle which is
#   which (each pair agrees to 2 mm, and no other pairing does).
